profile.title: Human Learning Systems
profile.canonical_definition: A public-service approach organized around human relationships, learning and systems conditions in complex environments.
profile.summary: HLS supplies one explicit route into Doncaster Thrive. Damian Allen uses it to explain why adaptive learning and relationality must be designed into public-service work.
profile.why_it_matters: It connects complexity arguments to practical public-service design while keeping relationships and learning central.
espoused_lineages: Damian Allen interview, diagram and correspondence
common_misreadings: HLS is not evidence that every relational intervention succeeds.
Learning language does not remove accountability.
open_checks: Add critical and evaluative literature beyond project self-description.
profile.editorial_note: Private material is paraphrased and locator-limited. Inference, recollection, public corroboration and unpublished theory remain distinguishable.
